thesis: Liquid, financeable and close to saturation. The reference project falls short of the fund's target, with little of its revenue secured; four hours wins de-rated capacity while two-hour assets still win connections. A fund buys operating assets that carry a toll, not new build.
流动性好、易于融资，但已接近饱和。参考项目达不到基金目标回报，且锁定的收入很少；四小时设计赢得折减后容量，两小时资产仍能拿到并网。基金应收购附带租赁合同的在运资产，而非新建。

reason: Tenth of seventeen markets on the design grid's hold IRR, 4.5% (29 October 2026).
按设计表测算的持有期IRR为4.5%（2026年10月29日），在十七个市场中排第十。
assetReturn.author: analyst

reason: On the design grid (16 October 2026), 12% of revenue is secured, for fifteen years.
按设计表测算（2026年10月16日），12%的收入已锁定，期限十五年。
revenueCertainty.author: analyst

reason: Readiness criteria and the connection register are published; the reformed process is recent.
成熟度标准与并网登记册均已公布；改革后的流程实施时间尚短。
approvalTransparency.author: analyst

reason: In the transmission register, as cited when graded on 23 October 2026, 177 GW is queued against 3.6 GW built; Ofgem's September 2026 figures count prioritised projects instead. The rules protecting queued batteries are under review.
输电登记册中（按2026年10月23日评级时引用），排队储能容量177GW，而已建成仅3.6GW；Ofgem 2026年9月的数据统计的是获优先安排的项目，口径不同。对排队电池项目的保护规则正在复议。
gridScarcity.author: analyst

reason: Zonal pricing was rejected in 2025 and capacity agreements are grandfathered.
分区电价方案已于2025年被否决，容量协议实行新老划断。
policyStability.author: analyst

reason: A governed data-centre demand series exists; no signed share of peak is established.
已有受治理的数据中心需求序列；尚未确定已签约负荷占峰值的比例。
demandGrowth.author: analyst

reason: Operating and committed storage sits near the 40% of peak edge.
已投运与已承诺的储能接近系统峰值40%的界线。
saturation.author: analyst

reason: Led European storage debt deals by count in the third quarter of 2026.
2026年第三季度欧洲储能债务融资笔数居首。
debtAvailability.author: analyst

text: The deepest storage debt market in Europe.
欧洲最成熟的储能债务融资市场。
Room to repeat the project many times over.
项目有多次复制的空间。
Zonal pricing was rejected and capacity agreements are grandfathered.
分区电价已被否决，容量协议实行新老划断。

despite: Ninth of fourteen markets on return, the lowest of these four.
回报在十四个市场中排第九，为这四个市场中最低。
strategic.author: analyst

text: Lenders finance storage here more readily than anywhere else in Europe.
这里的贷款人比欧洲其他任何地方都更愿意为储能融资。
Operating assets and platforms change hands.
在运资产和平台有实际交易。
Little revenue is secured in the reference case, so only assets that carry a toll.
参考情景下锁定的收入很少，因此只做带租赁合同的资产。

despite: The lowest modelled return of the four, in a fleet close to saturation.
模型回报为四个市场中最低，且机组规模已接近饱和。
infraFund.author: analyst
scoreNote: The score rose with the asset-return rank, which moved only because Japan fell below Great Britain on 2026-10-16. Nothing in Great Britain changed: the toll 4h play still loses value at a fund's yields, so the call stays Opportunistic.
评分随资产回报排名上升，而排名变动仅因日本于2026-10-16降至英国之下。英国本身并无变化：按基金收益率，租赁4小时方案仍然损失价值，因此结论维持“择机”。

text: A traded market with standard documents makes an acquisition the practical first step.
交易活跃、文件标准化，收购是切实可行的第一步。
The connection queue rules out starting from a new application.
并网排队状况使得从新申请起步不可行。

despite: The lowest modelled return of the four.
模型回报为四个市场中最低。
foreignFirstTimer.author: analyst

text: In the transmission register, as cited when graded on 23 October 2026, 177 GW is queued against 3.6 GW built, and the rules protecting queued batteries are under review.
输电登记册中（按2026年10月23日评级时引用），排队容量177GW而已建成仅3.6GW，对排队电池项目的保护规则正在复议。
Operating and committed storage is close to saturation.
已投运与已承诺的储能已接近饱和。

despite: The deepest market in which to sell a ready-to-build project, and the score reads it as a place to build a position.
这里是出售具备开工条件项目的最成熟市场，评分也将其视为值得提前布局。
scoreNote: The score reads a rationed queue as good for a developer. Here the rationing rule itself may turn against new batteries, and the grade cannot show that until the review concludes.
评分把需要争取的排队容量视为对开发商有利。但此处分配规则本身可能转向不利于新增电池项目，在复议结束之前评级无法反映这一点。

可能将Gate 2推进资格限于有收入支持的电池项目

source.publisher: DESNZ and Ofgem — open letter, 16 April 2026

note: Ofgem's CMP470 minded-to consultation of 17 September 2026 proposes a commitment fee for oversubscribed technologies; the decision is pending.
Ofgem于2026年9月17日发布CMP470倾向性咨询，拟对超额申请的技术类别收取承诺费；决定尚未作出。

label: Capacity Market · 4h
容量市场 · 4小时
why: Four hours wins de-rated capacity at the T-4 auction; on the capacity route two to four hours sit within the engine's band.
四小时设计在T-4拍卖中赢得折减后容量；在容量路径上，两至四小时均处于引擎的最优区间内。

text: Hold connections that can carry four hours, and enter T-4 with a four-hour design.
保有能承载四小时的并网容量，并以四小时设计参加T-4拍卖。

gb-cap-4h.author: analyst

label: Toll · 4h
租赁 · 4小时
why: A toll is the only way to secure most revenue in a market where the reference case secures little.
在参考情景锁定收入很少的市场，租赁是锁定大部分收入的唯一途径。

text: Buy only operating assets that carry a toll; read the Gate 2 policy before any greenfield exposure.
只收购附带租赁合同的在运资产；涉足绿地项目前先看清Gate 2政策。
